exposure: practitioner type (obstetrician/gynecologist, midwife, family practice physician)
cohort: 13,196 nulliparous women with term singleton vertex births and spontaneous onset of labor from the Consortium on Safe Labor database between 2002 and 2007.
finding: Significant variation in cesarean birth rates was found across hospitals and individual practitioners, with practitioner type and specialty being significantly associated with both cesarean birth rate and use of intrapartum interventions.
